summary_out.changed: Added a fifth orthogonal SKIP axis to the g3l2 four-gate stack: a signed mid-price velocity gate that skips BUY OPENs when mid drift over a 5s window is <= -0.50 $/s (~2 MES ticks/sec) and SELL OPENs when drift is >= +0.50 $/s. velocity_window_seconds=5.0 (half the flow window to avoid duplicating the trade-pressure time horizon), velocity_threshold=0.50 $/s, velocity_min_ticks=5. All four prior gate parameters frozen verbatim from g3l2 (flow_window=10s, flow_threshold=2.0, spread_window=60s, spread_quantile=0.75, min_samples=50, chop_window_ticks=30, chop_neutral=1.5, chop_min_ticks=40, size_asym_ratio=1.5). Composition: AND-skip across all five axes; quantity invariant preserved; anti-cascade contract preserved; per-gate counters extended with side-specific velocity skips.
summary_out.outcome: NULL RESULT. pnl=4180.25 vs base afg 1255.50 (+232.96%) and vs prior g3l2 4182.00 (-0.04%, inside the ±2% null band); sharpe=17.7665 vs g3l2 17.8049 (-0.0384 abs); max_drawdown=-0.015050 unchanged from g3l2; trade_count=96463 vs g3l2 96472 (-9 trades, -0.009%); win_rate=0.37030 vs g3l2 0.37031 (unchanged); mean_slippage=0.0; is_weighted_bps=0.04404 vs g3l2 0.04406 (unchanged within rounding). The velocity gate barely fired — 9 fewer trades on a ~96k base. Pre-stated null-result criterion is MET. g3l2 four-gate stack remains the island-1 lineage best.
summary_out.hypothesis: Signed mid-price velocity (a directional, price-native, quote-derived axis on a 5s window) would add residual EV-positive signal on top of the four-gate stack because it is structurally distinct from the existing four gates along multiple dimensions simultaneously: directional like flow but quote-derived not trade-derived, price-native like spread/chop but signed and rate-based not distance- or path-based. The hypothesis is falsified-as-stated at velocity_threshold=0.50 $/s; the 4-gate-conditioned surviving population either contains no meaningful slice with adverse 5s mid drift above 0.50 $/s (threshold sits in the empty tail of the conditional distribution), or the axis is genuinely redundant against the 4-gate pre-filter — without per-gate fire counts reproduced into a log we cannot fully discriminate, though the shape (near-zero fires on both sides) points to the threshold-too-loose explanation over the genuine-redundancy explanation.
summary_out.next: Two structurally distinct candidates for g4l2, both reading on this null. (A) TIGHTEN velocity threshold (knob retune of axis E) — drop velocity_threshold from 0.50 to 0.20-0.30 $/s (~1 MES tick/sec) so the gate fires meaningfully on the 4-gate-conditioned surviving distribution; cheap, narrow re-test of the same axis. (B) PIVOT to recent-trade-side flow (alternative 5th axis) — the candidate g3l2 originally named as more conservative, structurally different from velocity (conditions on TRADE-side, not mid-drift) and from base flow C (TRADE-side, not net-volume sign). Recommendation: (B) is higher information per loop because (A) is a single-knob sweep on an already-shown-inert mechanic at moderate threshold, whereas (B) introduces a structurally new candidate axis at the same loop cost. Cross-island signal for gen-4 migration: at velocity_threshold=0.50 $/s and 5s window, signed mid-velocity is INERT on top of a 4-gate stack on afg — null on the *axis*, not the *threshold*; this is a base-conditional finding, not a base-agnostic generalization.
